verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes a dedicated public REST API (zulip.com/api) with documented endpoints like 'Send a message', plus a bot framework built on this API for programmatic/interactive use, giving AI-native users a documented way to drive the product. Missing for 10: no confirmed OpenAPI/machine-readable spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404s), and no independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
